name: matmul_tensorcore
description: FP32 GEMM C=A*B with shapes m=10240, k=4096, n=8192. The locked reference is cuBLAS GemmEx (CUBLAS_COMPUTE_32F_FAST_16F, GEMM_DEFAULT_TENSOR_OP); on this host it lands somewhere in the 262–357 TFLOPS range depending on which algorithm cuBLAS dispatches (Ampere-style mma.sync vs Hopper wgmma). The bar to beat is set to ~600 TFLOPS / 1.145 ms, roughly 60% of H100's 989 TFLOPS dense FP16/FP32-accum peak — the realistic ceiling for a single tuned Hopper matmul kernel. cuBLAS/CUTLASS are forbidden inside the editable region; tensor-core PTX (mma.sync, wgmma), TMA, thread-block clusters / DSMEM, and mbarrier-based pipelines are all allowed.
